folds: stratified 5-fold (an image and its copies in one fold)
evaluation: out-of-fold, stratified 5-fold on the original training images (not their changed copies)
unclear_rule: the answer may only be real if neither our CLIP model nor Smaug says AI (>= 0.5); otherwise unclear. Chosen on 25 Nov from two live test images (an AI doodle the combiner called real, and an AI image our CLIP model called real), not from the test folder.
note: No test folder: every number here is an out-of-fold score of a training image (scored by models that saw neither it nor its changed copies). The held-out test is model/fullsize_robustness.py.
